name: Nintendo Co. Ltd.
thesis: STUB: Nintendo Co. Ltd. (NTDOY) is an evaluation candidate. Holdings JSON scaffolded by Phase F-3 to carry per-ticker break_rules for the eval brief — needs user-authored thesis + tier_1_kpis + DCF params if/when it graduates to portfolio.

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

business_model_rules.narrative: Revenue YoY < -15% for 2Q — console lifecycle valley too deep; mid-cycle Switch transition tolerance is -10% to +10%.
FCF margin < 15% for 2Q — Nintendo's structural floor even in console valleys is 20%+; sub-15 indicates first-party software tie-ratio breaking.
Op margin < 15% — IP-monetization profit pool breaking (theme parks, mobile, films should be absorbing console cyclicality).
